focus.name: player-surface-bounce-family
focus.purpose: Promote the Type-0x65 bounce actor and Type-0x5A/0x5B surface-mode response entries to behavior-based canonical names.

contracts.surface_mode: set TERRAIN_SURFACE_MODE to 0 for Type 0x5A or 1 for Type 0x5B, then enter PlayerCollision_ReinitializeResponseActor
contracts.bounce: on a falling overlap, promote Type 0x65 to Type 0x66 and install its bounce animation; if the interaction-animation gate is clear, launch PLAYER_VY=-0x0500 and arm/reset terrain response state
